== 1. declare
cafe-kinetics.json  metamodel shape (json.Unmarshal → metamodel.Model): 6 places, 6 transitions, 16 arcs
  places: beans milk cups orders brewing served
  declared rates: arrive=6 brew_espresso=0.01 brew_latte=0.002 leave=0.5 restock=0.2 serve=3
cafe.jsonld         editor shape (parser.ModelFromJSON): colors red/brown/white/blue → 8 unfolded places, 8 transitions, 25 arcs
  unfolded places: barista_free.red brewing.red open.red pantry.blue pantry.brown pantry.white queue.red served.red
  2 read arcs (the editor's output-side inhibitors), 2 inhibitor arcs, per-color capacity carried
cafe-order.json     metamodel shape: 7 places, 6 transitions — the order workflow step 7 verifies
metapetri.Convert reaches the same engine from both shapes: kinetics net 6 places / 6 transitions (0 conversion notes), theme net 8 places / 8 transitions (10 notes, all lossless)

== 3. fit
hidden rates and starting guesses:  arrive true 6.0000 guess 3.0000  leave true 0.5000 guess 1.5000  restock true 0.2000 guess 0.6000
objective: MSE over beans/orders/served at 12 times; parameters θ = ln k so no step can make a rate negative
Adam, forward sensitivities (400 iterations, learn rate 0.1)
  rate            true    fitted  rel.err
  arrive        6.0000    6.0150    0.25%
  leave         0.5000    0.4967    0.66%
  restock       0.2000    0.1989    0.53%
  loss 2277 → 0.1017   iterations 400   plain-solve equivalents 1606   gradient below tolerance: false
Adam, adjoint sensitivities (400 iterations, learn rate 0.1)
  rate            true    fitted  rel.err
  arrive        6.0000    6.0150    0.25%
  leave         0.5000    0.4967    0.66%
  restock       0.2000    0.1989    0.53%
  loss 2277 → 0.1017   iterations 400   plain-solve equivalents 804   gradient below tolerance: false
forward vs adjoint: largest relative difference 1.14e-05 — one objective, two gradient paths, one answer
recovery within 3% of truth on both paths: PASS (forward max 0.66%, adjoint max 0.66%)

== 4. ode / ssa / sde
stochastic.Solve on the fitted model, horizon 24, 25 grid points, seed 42; SSA and SDE average 200 realizations (portable PRNG)
  place          ODE  SSA mean     ± sd  SDE mean     ± sd
  beans        6.000     1.270    2.034     1.329    1.220
  milk         8.497    16.035    4.465     3.461    2.803
  cups         0.087     1.205    1.638     0.691    0.711
  orders      85.800    86.140   19.573    75.154   15.090
  brewing      0.402     0.300    0.794     1.055    1.159
  served       2.445     2.980    3.118     6.589    2.619
  SSA assumes: this engine assumes every step takes a random, exponentially distributed amount of time, which is the most erratic a shop can be for a given average.
  SDE assumes: this engine approximates the discrete firing process as continuous diffusion (the chemical Langevin equation), which is accurate when populations are large enough that the gap between SSA and this engine's mean is small (see the model's own consistency margin) and breaks down near zero, where a place's state is clamped rather than allowed to go negative.
portable SSA at the declared rates, seed 42, horizon 8, 5 samples, 1 realization: beans=0.000 milk=12.000 cups=6.000 orders=21.000 brewing=0.000 served=4.000
  equals fixtures/ssa-go-seed42.json (the showcase's cross-language golden): true

== 5. compare
  place          ODE  SSA mean  SDE mean    ODE-SSA    SDE-SSA
  beans        6.000     1.270     1.329     372.5%       4.6%
  milk         8.497    16.035     3.461      47.0%      78.4%
  cups         0.087     1.205     0.691      92.8%      42.6%
  orders      85.800    86.140    75.154       0.4%      12.8%
  brewing      0.402     0.300     1.055      10.2%      75.5%
  served       2.445     2.980     6.589      17.9%     121.1%
max relative gap ODE vs SSA mean: 372.5% at beans (relative to max(SSA mean, 1))
  orders (large population, weight-1 arcs) agree to 0.4%; the gap concentrates where beans run low.
  brew_espresso draws 2 beans: the ODE rate law is k·orders·beans·cups while the SSA and SDE propensity is k·orders·C(beans,2)·cups
  (docs/engine-selection.md, rule 3) — so the discrete engines empty the hopper faster and the continuous relaxation keeps more beans.
  spread      SSA sd    SDE sd   ratio
  beans        2.034     1.220    0.60
  milk         4.465     2.803    0.63
  cups         1.638     0.711    0.43
  orders      19.573    15.090    0.77
  brewing      0.794     1.159    1.46
  served       3.118     2.619    0.84
  the SDE carries SSA's propensities and a real variance band, but the chemical Langevin step is clamped at zero,
  so its mean and spread depart from SSA on the places that sit near empty (beans, cups) — the regime its own assumption names.

== 6. sensitivities
∂served(t=24)/∂k per transition at the fitted rates: learn forward sensitivities (analytic) beside sensitivity.Analyzer (central difference, h = 1% of k)
  transition             k     analytic  finite-diff  elasticity
  arrive            6.0150      -0.0114      -0.0114      -0.028
  brew_espresso     0.0100       1.5277       1.5278       0.006
  brew_latte        0.0020     -24.7051     -24.7127      -0.020
  leave             0.4967      -5.0087      -5.0092      -1.017
  restock           0.1989      11.9710      11.9710       0.974
  serve             3.0000      -0.0011      -0.0011      -0.001
  elasticity = (k/served)·∂served/∂k: a 1% change in the rate moves served by that many percent.

== 7. verify
cafe-kinetics.json: 0 P-invariants — an open system (arrive is a source, leave a sink); conservation lives in the workflow and the theme
cafe-order.json via metapetri.Convert + metapetri.Verify: 7 states explored, 7 proved / 1 refuted / 0 unknown
  proved   structural  one order token, conserved
  proved   structural  total tokens never change
  proved   structural  never both picked up and refunded
  proved   exhaustive  no refund on a collected drink
  proved   exhaustive  a refund is possible
  proved   structural  bounded
  proved   exhaustive  every order ends
  refuted  exhaustive  deadlock-free (expected refuted: an order that ends is a deadlock)
           witness: pay → cancel → refund → {refunded=1}
cafe.jsonld (unfolded theme): 2 proved / 0 refuted / 0 unknown; the conversion recorded 10 notes, none lossy
  proved   structural  one barista: free or brewing
  proved   structural  never free and brewing at once

== 8. mcp
the same files reach petri-pilot's MCP server (https://pilot.pflow.xyz/mcp, or `petri-pilot mcp` on stdio) as these calls.
<file> stands for the file's contents passed as the string argument; observations.json is step 2's output. Documentation only — nothing here touches the network.
  petri_analyze    {"full":true,"model":"<cafe-kinetics.json>"}
  petri_stochastic {"model":"<cafe-kinetics.json>","rates":{"arrive":6.015,"brew_espresso":0.01,"brew_latte":0.002,"leave":0.4967,"restock":0.1989,"serve":3},"realizations":50,"samples":25,"seed":42,"tspan":"[0, 24]"}
  petri_fit        {"fixed_rates":{"brew_espresso":0.01,"brew_latte":0.002,"serve":3},"max_iter":400,"method":"adam","model":"<cafe-kinetics.json>","observations":"<observations.json>","parameters":{"arrive":[0.6,60],"leave":[0.05,5],"restock":[0.02,2]}}
  petri_verify     {"model":"<cafe-order.json>","properties":["new + paid + brewing + ready + picked_up + cancelled + refunded == 1","conserves","mutex:picked_up,refunded","unreachable:picked_up=1,refunded=1","reachable:refunded=1","bounded","terminating","deadlock-free"]}
  petri_verify     {"model":"<cafe.jsonld>","properties":["barista_free + brewing == 1","mutex:barista_free,brewing"]}
  notes: petri_stochastic caps realizations at 50; petri_fit is bounded Nelder-Mead or Adam in k (not ln k) and defaults to the midpoint of each bound;
  the pilot unfolds cafe.jsonld through parser.ModelFromJSON itself, and a base name in a property sums over its colors.
